acceptanceCriteria: Recognizably belongs to the Werebeasts family and preserves every identity invariant.
Reads specifically as Half-turned, T2, rather than another family form.
Communicates the Crouch-Pounce Soldier (Soldier) archetype and its battlefield duty.
Preserves coherent load-bearing anatomy, complete limbs, and believable ground contact.
Uses at least two earth construction dimensions without a palette-only or glow-only treatment.
Keeps the attack telegraph and counterplay signal visible at gameplay scale.
Frames one complete featured subject with no crop, labels, UI text, or watermark.
Output remains a candidate until independent approved-review evidence exists; it is never a runtime asset.
anatomyInvariants: Crouched hybrid with elongated snout, fur across back and arms, human-like legs, and clothing hanging in strips.
Signature mechanic: Half-Turn Pounce: the hybrid drops its shoulders, lunges along the muzzle line, then must haul one not-yet-digitigrade leg underneath itself.
battlefieldDuty: Repeat a readable pounce from a crouched hybrid posture and reset through a vulnerable upright turn.
constructionDimensions: Material/structure branches: T1 patchy fur and long fingers carry mineral-set torn-seam tabs; T2 the emerging muzzle and hybrid shoulders gain sediment cheek braces; T3 digitigrade hocks and mature claws gain crystal load keys; T4 the broken chain and iron collar gain compressed mineral links; T5 the horn-and-antler crown and broken runes gain fractured load sockets.

Motion/process branches: T1 a planted reach with long fingers loads one torn seam fault; T2 the hybrid pounce transfers weight through a muzzle-side brace; T3 digitigrade crosscuts alternate claw-key loads; T4 chain rotation commits the collar anchor; T5 each crown rune roots and releases one arena load.
counterplay: Leave the muzzle lane and punish the recovering rear leg before the crouch reforms. Affinity signal: Affinity counterplay branches: T1 the patchy-fur torn seam reveals its mineral fault after the planted reach; T2 the hybrid muzzle brace fractures after the pounce; T3 a digitigrade landing exposes the active claw load key; T4 the chain-and-collar anchor cracks after a full rotation; T5 the crown rune exposes its load socket when the commanded root releases.
forbiddenTreatments: Mass that hides the transformation silhouette
identityInvariants: A human frame progressively stretches toward animal proportions while hands, shoulders, legs, muzzle, and tail change at explicit tiers.
Gray, black, russet, or silver fur remains distinct from torn muted human clothing, hide, iron restraints, claw, and fang.
Shredded dress, snapped restraints, ritual scars, and restrained moon motifs record the unfinished transformation without defining an affinity.
Loss of human proportion escalates from patchy changes to an authored sovereign transformation while readable joints remain exposed.
telegraph: The elongated snout lowers and fur across the back lifts as clothing strips trail straight behind.
